pages.text: $(#D2691E)🔥 Forged in Lava · Sunfire Elixir ☀$()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)「Sipping the fire of the earth, forging an indomitable body」$()$(br)The blazing heat of $(#FF8C00)dried ginger$(), the richness of $(#DAA520)rock honey$(), and the deep aroma of $(#8B0000)aged black tea$() boil together before being completed with a sprinkle of $(#4169E1)cornflower petals$()—thus, the warrior’s elixir, capable of $(l)turning flesh into steel$(), is tempered.

$(#FF8C00)▌ Furnace Trio $()$(br2)$(l)$(#CD5C5C)🛡 Flames Bow Down$()$(br)Even the $(#FF4500)kiss of magma$() feels like a warm breeze.$(br2)$(l)$(#8B0000)💪 Giant’s Pulse$()$(br)Muscle fibers tense like $(#DAA520)steel cables$().$(br2)$(l)$(#00BFFF)⚡ Crimson Hare’s Sprint$()$(br)Feet spark with $(#FFD700)fiery bursts$(), enhancing speed.

$(br2)$(#8B0000)▌ Alchemical Forge Notes $()$(br)- Roast $(#FF8C00)ginger slices$() until their edges curl and turn $(#CD3700)charred brown$().$(br)- $(#DAA520)Honey$() must be mixed with $(#4B0082)cornflower$() until it forms $(#FFD700)silken strands$().$(br)- Pour $(#8B0000)tea infusion$() from a height to form a $(#00CED1)golden amber vortex$().$(br2)$(#FF0000)⚠$() If the liquid emits $(#7FFF00)green steam$(), it means the ginger concentration is too high.

$(br2)$(#8B4513)『 Epic of the Forge 』$()$(br)A dwarven blacksmith’s battle hymn:$(br)'When the $(#FF8C00)flames of ginger$() churn within the $(#8B0000)iron stomach$(),$(br)even the $(#CD5C5C)Infernal Behemoth$() will envy this $(#FF4500)fire-resistant flesh$()—$(br)and as the $(#00BFFF)wind$() rushes past the $(#DAA520)honey-gilded armor$(),$(br)it beats like the war drums of a warrior charging into $(#4169E1)glory$().'
